notes.title: Brightness slider and UI update
notes.notes:
Princess Vira, the dungeons were too dark and no one could see!  The mason's have provided an option for more light!

In this update:

[list]
[*] Added a brightness slider
[*] Improved appearance of various UI
[/list]

May the moon bless your journeys,
LimeBlossom

notes.title: Unlocked FPS Bugfix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45281493/9546a1afd3f7cb7924772c2c599ffa97fb1c551e.gif[/img]
Hey everyone, hope you're enjoying time with the doggos!

Some players noted their computers were overheating when playing, likely due to the unlocked framerate using as much resources as available.

We're planning on allowing users to set their own fps and to enable vsync in the future.

Let us know if you have any other issues.

LimeBlossom
